production_blockers.detail: The authenticated connector and existing strategy require exact current review and explicit user confirmation for every mutation.
The production adapter exists, but no separately authorized provider transport, renewal behavior, exact account binding, or release-bound launcher was supplied or authenticated.

The authenticated MCP does not advertise advanced-order reads or expose broker-preserved client references, so the stock launcher cannot prove whole-account reconciliation or ambiguous-submission recovery.
Sequential verified protection is implemented but its residual non-atomic halt, gap, outage, and submission-to-ack risk requires the consolidated owner decision.
Massive, Robinhood instrument/quality, Gmail, and control clients are implemented as release-bound injection seams but are not authenticated in the installed stock launcher.
The staged percentage overlay and numeric score, spread, depth, A+, sequential-protection, and notification-failure decisions remain unapproved; synthetic test values were not promoted.
No production destination, provider authorization, worker health, owner-confirmed route test, or provider receipt exists. Local JSONL cannot satisfy readiness.

The existing heartbeat was not disabled or drained, and the stock release has no supported read-only Codex scheduler control-plane adapter to prove its exact runtime identity. A paused TOML file is insufficient, so no fresh hash-bound retirement receipt can be recorded.
